license_scope: CC BY 4.0 covers the contributors' rights in the derived data. Original SCEDC records remain subject to source terms and attribution requirements; this release does not relicense third-party material.

provenance.description: Processed full-record ground-motion event HDF5 sample and fixed-snapshot (t0 = 5 s) HDF5 collection. Raw waveform downloads and the complete full-record dataset are not included.

sample.selection: First 81 full-record HDF5 filenames in lexicographic event-ID order. Convenience sample only; not a random or representative sample.

publication_scope: Partial full-record sample plus the snapshot collection, selected checkpoints and complete archived result tables. This release does not contain all full-record HDF5 files needed for complete retraining.
